body_markdown:
[Nile Post] Uganda has reiterated there are no confirmed active Ebola cases, following reports of a confirmed infection in Nigeria involving a woman who travelled to the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) for business. (AllAfrica)

**Vanguard** adds: Fresh facts emerged, yesterday, regarding the travel itinerary of the confirmed Ebola virus patient in the Federal Capital Territory, FCT, revealing that the index case entered Nigeria aboard an Ethiopian Airlines flight earlier this month. Read Also: No vaccine, specific treatment for Ebola strain in Nigeria — WHO A highly-placed aviation official, who spoke on the condition of anonymity, as she was not authorised to brief the media on the matter, told Vanguard that the patient arrived in the country on October 3, 2026.

This digest was assembled automatically from reporting by Vanguard and AllAfrica. Follow the source links below for the full coverage.
